chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 333 – Word-Sword Chop & Yu Wei’s Embrace: Ji Ning’s Rage Unleashed
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s fury erupts when Yu Wei is poisoned. He unleashes the seventh stance of the Three-Foot Sword—sword-light as silken strands—killing Xiamang Qi and Feixue in seconds. A raw, long-awaited embrace follows.
og_title: Desolate Era 333 – The Word-Sword Chop Burns Through the Assembly
og_description: Ji Ning’s Sword Heart explodes as he watches Yu Wei fall. He slashes through imperial geniuses with silken sword-light—and finally stops hesitating.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 333: Ji Ning Goes Berserk with Sword-Light Silk
twitter_description: Xiamang Qi dies. Feixue Realperson falls. And Ji Ning finally holds Yu Wei in his arms. This is the breakthrough everyone was waiting for.

lore_anchors.definition: The pinnacle of sword mastery in Xianxia, where a sword immortal compresses their blade's power into an impossibly thin, infinitely sharp filament, capable of cutting through magic treasures and Fiendgod bodies alike.
A divine ability that refines hundreds of rare poisons into the user's palm, turning any touch into a lethal injection that bypasses physical defenses and corrupts the victim's Ki circulation.
The mortal-world trial zone of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, a sealed arena where contestants must gather talismans, battle for survival, and prove their mettle over the course of a real-time year.

The threshold realm of Dao comprehension where a cultivator can project their understanding as a persistent field of influence, often required before executing the most advanced stances of supreme sword arts.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning's sword-light suddenly transform into silken strands?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It happened because his raging emotions and desperate will to protect Yu Wei shattered his mental barriers, allowing the seventh stance of the Three-Foot Sword—the Word-Sword Chop—to manifest. The year of relentless battle had prepared his body; the sight of her falling ignited his Dao Heart.
Yes. Ji Ning's Water-Fire Lotus ground his flesh and soul into absolute nothingness, preventing any means of recovery or reincarnation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ninefate Recluse retreat instead of continuing to fight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She realized that Ji Ning's newly acquired 'sword-light silken strands' could cut through her freakishly durable Fiendgod body with ease. Fighting him to the death was no longer a safe gamble, and both she and Blackstone Recluse had already collected enough talismans.
